items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bernie Glow was one of the men that use to play in the band. He was something else boy, beautiful cat too, man. Bernie and I were very good friends.

ctx.x: So they were good cats, there were good guys in the band. You got along with them.

Yeah, he use to play, he use to be one of the men that would play in the band cause they, they called a lot of men in, but Bernie Glow was one of the men that use to play in the band. He was something else boy, beautiful cat too, man. Bernie and I were very good friends. When we lost Bernie that was too bad, I kind of... Bernie wrote up a big article on me about my trumpet playing and our friendship and everything. And, that‘s before he got to be famous, when I first met him. That was back when I was back with…

So, you‘re with this band, and is it satisfying? Is the work … I mean, after having left Count Basie is the work satisfying, are you happy playing in this band? We know the money‘s good, but is the music good?
